coding.note: Claims are deduplicated across the abstract, introduction, and contribution list; the infrastructure contribution contains two distinct systems techniques. The model contribution is coded EFF because its stated contribution is performance/cost efficiency, not a novel architectural element. Previously attributed DeepSeekMoE, QK normalization, and auxiliary-loss-free balancing are adopted techniques rather than claimed author innovations. No novel ARCH or TRAIN contribution is identified, so C2 is NA throughout. Multiple-run averaging on page 9 concerns evaluation sampling, not independent training runs, so seeds is NR. Data processing details and a Chinese/English ratio are disclosed, but corpus sources and a reconstructable source mixture are not. Comparators include both main base-model and instruction-model tables. External benchmark names do not establish independent third-party evaluation.

claims.quote: We propose a scalable and fine-grained three-stage data processing
claims.claim: A scalable, fine-grained three-stage processing framework produces high-quality, diverse pretraining data, with the process openly documented.

claims.quote:
We introduce dots.llm1, an open-source model that activates
  only 14B parameters during inference while delivering comprehensive and computationally
  efficient performance.
claims.claim: Release dots.llm1, a 142B-total/14B-active MoE model delivering competitive performance at reduced training and inference cost, pretrained without synthetic data or model distillation.

claims.quote: we introduce an innovative MoE all-to-all communication and computation
claims.claim: An innovative MoE all-to-all communication/computation overlap recipe based on interleaved 1F1B pipeline scheduling.

claims.quote: overlapping recipe based on 1F1B pipeline scheduling and an efficient grouped GEMM implementation
claims.claim: An efficient grouped GEMM implementation boosts MoE computational efficiency.

claims.quote:
By releasing intermediate training checkpoints as
  open-source, we aim to empower the research community with transparency into the training
claims.claim: Open-source intermediate checkpoints at every trillion tokens to enable transparency and research into model learning dynamics.
